rulings.item: One regen costs 19-23 min on mei and 28.7 min on a 7-core slot, above the 15 min line, so it cannot be added to every train as it is
rulings.recommendation: a story first that builds libc.a only for the traces, reruns only the grouping and dead-key step instead of a second full so, and runs the traces in parallel (estimated 6-7 min for both profiles, to be measured on mei); then resume this story. If both profiles still exceed 15 min on mei: fast on every train, release on a schedule

informational: A no-change cargo xtask so rebuilds nothing in cargo (fingerprint log: no dirty unit) yet takes 282-284 s fast and 386 s release on a 7-core slot. The layout contract check is 126 s of the fast run (45%), and every gate and plant baseline pays it
build_tag hashes crates/ including the lists, so a list change changes LIELLA_BUILD_TAG; it measured only +8 s (292 vs 284 s) and is not the cost
Role sh1 holds regenerated lists and fast products built from them after the measurement; re-sync it before using it again
improvement: The layout contract check is 45% of every no-change cargo xtask so (126 of 282 s, fast). Caching its verdict by product hash, or running it only where layout matters, would save about 2 min in every gate, plant baseline and regen
